CHAPTER 6 · ITEM 05 / 12

Price ceilings and floors

Wage bill and elasticities工資總額與彈性

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Calculate total wage payments as wage times employment. Use the elasticity of labor demand to assess how a wage increase affects total payments; use both labor supply and demand responses to assess unemployment.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

總工資為工資乘就業。勞工需求缺乏彈性時，工資升幅超過就業跌幅，總支付上升；失業變化則同時涉及供給與需求。

Total wage payments equal wage times employment. Along inelastic labor demand, a wage rise reduces employment proportionately less, raising the wage bill. Unemployment changes depend on both labor demand and labor supply responses.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：Wage 10→12 and employment 100→95: total payments 1,000→1,140. 勞工總收入上升，但五人失去工作。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

A small wage increase on elastic labor demand does what to total wage payments? 有彈性勞工需求下小幅加薪？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
